title: The Credits Hide A Wild Teaser Part 5

cuts.voiceover_text: These credits are already glowing like a dream, but the real surprise is what they are hiding. Figures flash through a green web of light. Faces appear and disappear inside the storm. The ending starts feeling less like a goodbye and more like a warning. The colors keep shifting, the silhouettes keep moving, and the screen refuses to settle on one final image.

The green montage breaks into stark figures and production text, then the words announce the ending theme, Hunting for Your Dream. A bright star opens into a grid of light. The image snaps to a purple studio logo, then a red-eyed close-up, and finally the Hunter x Hunter title card. The credits look finished, but the show still has one more strange idea to reveal.

That title card fades into a softer, almost playful world. Gon and Killua appear beside the logo, followed by colorful production cards and familiar faces. Then the tone gets even stranger. The boys pop up in a tiny classroom with a board behind them, as if the anime has suddenly decided to become a lesson. Gon looks ready to learn. Killua looks ready for trouble.

At first, Gon and Killua look harmless, standing in front of the classroom display. The board fills with diagrams and a huge X. Then a hulking image of Uvogin appears. Before the lesson can explain anything, a giant fist crashes into the frame. Gon and Killua recoil. The screen slams up one word: Next. The joke lands like a threat, because even the educational segment apparently comes with casualties.

Then the preview flashes the Hunter x Hunter logo and cuts through a new group of faces. Gon and Killua sit together in one scene, then look down at a broad object while an older man works nearby. Another man stares forward with a hard, unsettling expression. A figure in a red jacket steps into view. The final image holds on a tense face before the screen drops back into French credits. The lesson never explains itself. It simply leaves the door open for whatever comes next.

series.summary: The ending credits shift into a playful Gon-and-Killua classroom teaser, where Uvogin appears before a sudden punch and a final montage of other characters.
